tools.name: compare_programs
tools.description: Runs the multifamily.online comparison app on one 5+ unit building: for Fannie Mae DUS and Small Loans, Freddie Mac Optigo Conventional and Conventional Small, and HUD 223(f), 221(d)(4) and 223(a)(7), returns whether it fits the published limits (or why not), max loan by LTV/LTC and by DSCR, the bin

tools.name: get_program_terms
tools.description: Published limits for one multifamily loan program or all of them, as multifamily.online lists them: max LTV or LTC, minimum DSCR, term and amortization, prepayment, recourse, structure, HUD mortgage insurance where it applies, and the agency source document with its date and URL. Covers Fannie Mae D

tools.name: get_treasury_yields
tools.description: The latest 5-, 7- and 10-year U.S. Treasury par yields and overnight SOFR that the multifamily.online app builds its example rate on, each with its as-of date, the reading a week and a month earlier when available, freshness status and the publisher link (U.S. Treasury, New York Fed).
